name: Theresa Reinhart
source: A crafty and underhanded highroller that uses whatever tactics she can to win. However, this sort of method has gotten her into trouble and also has made it so she has issues trusting other people’s intentions, thinking they require a transaction of some sort. Sneaky, crass, and flirtatious, the woman is the very definition of a femme fatale. Why she’s participating in The Game of Fourtune is currently a mystery.
